correctness.rationale: Homma–Kim representation and Homma equivalence criterion reduce all smooth degree-five plane-filling F3 curves to irreducible characteristic cubics modulo affine scalar/shift. The eight cubic polynomials form two orbits of sizes two and six, as verified from coefficient transforms. For each companion representative, the given affine equation over F_{3^n}, together with exactly four rational points at infinity, was independently exhaustively enumerated for ALL n=1..6 using a new finite-field implementation: A point counts (13,13,55,13,208,913); B (13,13,16,117,273,640). The genus-six Weil functional equation and Newton identities reconstruct all twelve coefficients from n≤6, not from infinite extrapolation. Separate exact mod-2 irreducibility tests of the quartic and degree-12 factors support the simple isogeny decomposition; middle coefficients coprime to 3 prove ordinarity. Geometric two-class classification is explicitly a prior theorem, not novel.
residual_risks: The full geometric classification is externally proved; these checks independently confirm arithmetic and algebraic consequences rather than reproving Homma–Kim.
